newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Mining Q1 net loss 38 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila Mining Q1 net loss 38 mln pesos.

text.p: Manila Mining Corp posted a net loss of 38 million pesos in the first quarter of the year due to lower grades of gold mined, president Artemio Disini said on Monday during the stockholders' meeting.
"But we are confident to turn around our finances for the rest of the year and be able to resolve our metallurgical problems," Disini said.
Disini attributed the drop in the company's net earnings in the first quarter to lower ore grades in its mine in the southern Philippines.
The gold miner is expected to post a net income of 30 million pesos this year compared with 21.62 million pesos in 1996, Disini said.
"Geologic and technical problems led to very modest profits for the company (in 1996)," chairman Felipe Yap told shareholders.
Disini said Manila Mining has allocated 135 million pesos to open up a new pit in the mine, which is expected to yield better ore grades, and for the purchase of equipment.
The company has also hired a new geological consultant to solve the company's problem of low tonnage and poor mill recoveries.
